P="$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/context-mode/context-mode/1.0.169"; python3 -c "
import json, os, sys
p = sys.argv[1]
pj = json.load(open(os.path.join(p, '.claude-plugin', 'plugin.json')))
entries = json.load(open(os.path.expanduser('~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json')))['plugins']['context-mode@context-mode']
m = [x for x in entries if x.get('installPath') == p]
print('plugin.json version:', pj['version'])
print('installed_plugins.json entry version:', m[0]['version'] if m else None, '| gitCommitSha:', m[0]['gitCommitSha'] if m else None)
print('note: a Claude marketplace install takes no commit ref (recipes/README.md), so this legitimately drifts past the reviewed 6f0cc684 Codex --ref; not asserted equal here')
" "$P" && echo "server.bundle.mjs sha256 $(sha256sum "$P/server.bundle.mjs" | cut -c1-16)... | node $(node --version) | mcporter $(mcporter --version) | node_modules: $([ -d "$P/node_modules" ] && echo present || echo absent)" && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" context-mode
